answer_1.quote: We conduct multi-turn dialogue generation experiments on two public datasets, DailyDialog and OpenSubtitles.

answer_2.quote: We consider three automatic evaluation metrics: BLEU, Distinct (Dist). ... we also evaluate BLEURT, an advanced learned semantic-sensitive evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we recruit five evaluators to manually judge 500 samples from all models in blind testing. Evaluators rate samples from three aspects: readability (Read.), coherency (Coh.), and informative (Info.).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate each sample on readability, coherency, and informativeness, scoring 0 (bad), 1 (borderline), or 2 (good).
